brief: Titles are bold dark text directly on white or ordinary panel background: NO coloured title ribbons, tabs, header bars, white reversed headings, or whole-figure banner. Soft colour highlights only meaningful interior content and the key mechanism; avoid a repeated card-header grid. Use a clear matched family of moderately bold, slightly hand-drawn shaft arrows with solid readable triangular heads and palette-matched ink. Keep planned endpoints and exact centerlines; all shafts continuous beside text, including across model titles. Equal peer regions and clean rectangular outer silhouette remain. Retain the 3×3 balanced macro arrangement and the actual collected piano-waveform slot. Give each scientific region a free-standing bold dark heading, with no header ribbon or filled title area. Use small pale indigo cells for CLAP/token content and one amber RVQ mechanism emphasis. The semantic LM is one compact whole-model block; do not expose invented Transformer layers or duplicate oversized model blocks. Keep the actual waveform slot white and empty for post-placement. Scheme arrows are moderately bold hand-drawn dark indigo/navy strokes with identical triangular heads; text conditioning bypasses the sampling region in its exact reserved lane. Keep scientific tokens typeset, including subscripts, and schematic analysis labelled as such.

ideas.concept: Scientific content hierarchy with recognizable model construction and a coherent arrow family.
